title: Water Main Leak/Break
description: Use this service request to report a water main leak or main break on a public right of way. The estimated response time for this service request is 1 business day.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a water-main leak or break in a public right-of-way.
actions.why: For a water main leak or break on a public street, alley, sidewalk, by a water meter or fire hydrant, or another public right-of-way location. The 311 request form asks where the leak is, whether water is spewing, bubbling, seeping, or at low flow, and whether it damages property or the roadway.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Water Inquiries and Line Locates" > Choose "Water Main Leak/Break"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Water Inquiries and Line Locates" > Choose "Water Main Leak/Break"
